notes: Yield, cost and degradation values are configurable planning assumptions, not guarantees. Edit this file to update them.

Subsidy follows the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana residential CFA structure: ₹30,000/kW for the first 2 kW, ₹18,000/kW for the third kW, capped at ₹78,000 for residential rooftop systems. Availability depends on the DISCOM, vendor registration and application approval.
Commercial and industrial consumers are not eligible for the residential CFA and are shown zero subsidy here; state-level incentives may differ.
